sloka: यावत् इच्छसि रत्नानि हिरण्यम् वा द्विजोत्तम ।तावत् ददामि ते सर्वम् दीयताम् शबला मम ॥१-५३-२१॥
transliteration: yāvat icchasi ratnāni hiraṇyam vā dvijottama ।tāvat dadāmi te sarvam dīyatām śabalā mama ॥1-53-21॥

translations.english: O Best of brahmins I shall offer you jewels or gold as much as you desire. I shall give you everything. Give this Sabala to me".
